rows.note: Proposed recurring nonclinical term: module = मोड्युल.
Uses the proposed recurring nonclinical term module = मोड्युल.

rows.en: Give examples of MHPSS activities in humanitarian programming
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा गरिने MHPSS गतिविधिहरूका उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give examples of MHPSS activities carried out in humanitarian programme planning and implementation.

rows.en: Support the use of the MSP by humanitarian actors from diverse sectors/clusters/AORs
rows.ne: विभिन्न क्षेत्र/क्लस्टर/AORs मा संलग्न मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूद्वारा MSP को प्रयोगमा सहयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Support the use of the MSP by parties involved in humanitarian work who are engaged in different sectors/clusters/AORs.
rows.note: AORs is retained without an inferred expansion.

rows.en: Support the use of the MSP to assess the quality of MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको गुणस्तर आकलन गर्न MSP को प्रयोगमा सहयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Support the use of the MSP to assess the quality of MHPSS activities.

rows.note: Proposed recurring nonclinical terms: group exercise = समूह अभ्यास; activity showcase = गतिविधि प्रदर्शनी.
Uses the proposed recurring nonclinical terms group exercise = समूह अभ्यास and activity showcase = गतिविधि प्रदर्शनी.

rows.en: For each activity you are allocated, create a display that answers the following questions:
rows.ne: तपाईंलाई जिम्मा दिइएको प्रत्येक गतिविधिका लागि निम्न प्रश्नहरूको उत्तर समेटिएको प्रदर्शनी सामग्री तयार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For each activity assigned to you, prepare exhibition material that includes answers to the following questions.
What is this activity related to?

rows.en: What is the first action you would take in implementing the activity?
rows.ne: यो गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्दा तपाईंले सबैभन्दा पहिले गर्ने कार्य के हो?
rows.bt: What is the very first action you take when implementing this activity?

rows.en: Is there a key consideration for this activity?
rows.ne: यस गतिविधिका लागि कुनै मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष छ?
rows.bt: Is there any key aspect to consider for this activity?

rows.en: If yes, what is the key idea.
rows.ne: यदि छ भने, त्यसको मुख्य विचार के हो?
rows.bt: If there is, what is its main idea?
rows.note: The back-translation changes 'key idea' to 'main intent', shifting the question toward purpose. Revised to ask for the key idea. The condition changes from an affirmative answer ('If yes') to existence ('If there is').

rows.bt: + Walking around the exhibition and observing
